style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and flat lays, light neutral #F4F7F8 for infographic screens, real outdoor grass/alpine environments for scene shots, deep navy #1F4A5C for info and CTA panels

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent outdoor camping gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, lake blue #2E9BC6, deep navy #1F4A5C and one amber-yellow accent #F2C94C; natural soft daylight outdoors and clean high-key studio light indoors with one clear light direction and soft realistic contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines in #2D2D2D on light panels or #FFFFFF on dark and outdoor panels; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line icon style; authentic outdoor product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable front 3/4 hero angle and scale for the tent with clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle and scale for the tent across the set, tent always fully pitched and never clipped unless macro
style.surfaceSystem: flat grass campsite ground, rocky alpine meadow, and seamless studio sweep
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short bold headlines in #2D2D2D on light panels and #FFFFFF on dark or outdoor panels
